agents.name: chief-of-staff
agents.description: Review and optimize the day's schedule, summarize communications, and triage incoming alerts into prioritized action items.

agents.name: personal-assistant
agents.description: Handle day-to-day house and utility coordination, query/control smart home devices, and track online order status or item wishlists.

agents.name: devils-advocate
agents.description: Actively challenge architectural decisions, expose security risks, find edge cases, and probe for weaknesses in technical proposals.

agents.name: financial-auditor
agents.description: Manage budgeting, track daily expenses, audit active subscriptions, and provide cost-benefit analysis for software or lifestyle changes.

agents.name: lifestyle-coach
agents.description: Design personalized physical fitness and skill-learning tracks, monitor goals, and suggest routine modifications to sustain progress.

agents.name: lifestyle-concierge
agents.description: Recommend restaurants, cafes, and takeaways, and suggest personalized entertainment like movies, books, or shows.

agents.name: nutrition-advisor
agents.description: Formulate healthy recipes, design weekly meal plans, track dietary/nutritional goals, and produce consolidated grocery lists for online ordering.

agents.name: product-manager
agents.description: Analyze project requirements and documentation, write user stories, create feature maps, and orchestrate engineering resources.

agents.name: backend-developer
agents.description: Write clean, secure, and conventional server-side code (PHP/Laravel/Go) and manage database migrations.

agents.name: frontend-developer
agents.description: Implement modern responsive web interfaces using CSS and framework components (Vue/React).

agents.name: code-quality-reviewer
agents.description: Perform audits on pull request diffs, checking for style guidelines, linting issues, and potential code smells.

agents.name: infrastructure-engineer
agents.description: Monitor server status, check backups, scan package repositories for breaking upgrades, and manage vulnerability alerts/CVEs.

agents.name: prompt-architect
agents.description: Design, evaluate, and tune system instructions and prompts for model routing.

agents.name: database-administrator
agents.description: Prune long-term logs, summarize conversation databases, and run memory maintenance scripts to maintain token efficiency.
